review_round_1.finding: The original getter read rk.ap.ref.body_offset_28, which stayed at constructor zeros while target picking updated unit_.hull_aim_ref.
review_round_1.fix: RocketHostAdapter::target_ref_state returns unit_.hull_aim_ref; the arm passes that reference into RocketAimInputs and the release getter reads its body_offset_28. The input requires an explicit producer reference; there is no default fallback to task-ref zeros.
review_round_1.lifecycle: Both kz_enter_pick_009fa260 and kz_target_point write hull_aim_ref. Dirty repicks and bias are therefore read from their actual result; hull_aim_world_point reconstructs that same object on retarget, and aim_point_freeze_009fada0 retains it across death-head and observer freezes. No producer, repick, retarget or freeze policy is replaced or run twice.
review_round_1.regression: One regression in tests/math_tests.cpp uses approach_target_ref_pick_009fa260 to produce nonzero hull offsets plus bias, repicks, reconstructs the retained object for a new bias-only target, and freezes with approach_target_ref_freeze_009fadae. The borrowed RocketAimInputs stays bound to that object and every offset must reach release.homing_point while task.ap.ref.body_offset_28 remains zero.
review_round_1.red_check: bsp_math_tests.exe exited 1 on the new regression while the release getter still used t.ap.ref; this reproduced the review finding.
